Generate diagnostic dashboard for single time series

Source: R/dashboard_single.R
dashboard_single.Rd

Creates an interactive HTML diagnostic dashboard for a single hierarchical time series object, showing model diagnostics, plots, and quality metrics.

Usage

dashboard_single(x, file = NULL, title = "Diagnostics")

Arguments

x

A single time series object (class x13Single or tramoseatsSingle)

file

Optional file path to save HTML output

title

Main title for the dashboard (default: "Diagnostics")

Value

Browsable HTML UI containing the diagnostic dashboard

Note

This is an internal function; use createDashboard() instead for the public API.

Examples

obj <- perX13(AirPassengers, "rsa3")
obj$run()
createDashboard(obj)  # preferred
